record.question: Which country conferred Prime Minister Narendra Modi 'Amir Amanullah Khan Award', the highest civilian honour of that country?
record.explanation: Answer A: Afghanistan. Afghanistan conferred its Amir Amanullah Khan Award on Narendra Modi in June 2016. The Prime Minister's Office contemporary release names the country, award and presenting president. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=145981. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
